label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: What is necessary per se and the cause of necessity…
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., tertia via: quod omnes dicunt Deum
interpretation: A nominal identification kept separate from the conclusion, as for the prima via and quarta via: it reports how the name 'God' is used of the per se necessary being. It is not used by any result.
